name: R9.3 Take leave requests, check the balance and route to the manager

nodes.name: Step 1: Request or cancellation
nodes.notes: Your signed-in leave form calls this. Body: {request_id, employee (the signed-in email), type, start, end, action: request | cancel}; no free-text reason.

nodes.name: Step 6: Manager decides
nodes.notes: The approval calls this when the manager, stand-in or HR decides. Body: {request_id, decision: approved | declined, by}.

nodes.name: Step 6: Morning reminders
nodes.notes: Step 6's reminders: 2 working days to the manager, 4 to the stand-in and HR.
